notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.notes:
Do you remember the devlog in which the issue of gang members was mentioned and how they can help you? As it is in life, you don’t always find the right people. And it will be like that in Chop Shop Simulator. Wrongly selected people can destroy the whole action and help the police find you. Below is a photo of the car of one of the more enormous gang bosses, recruiting people without any consideration. So ends recklessness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/f2736c0175e78c53625e9c757a6fc8ffc9e6b7e4.png[/img]

The wrong people can frustrate your plans in all sorts of ways. Push you out of the way while escaping in a hijacked car, notify the police of your objectives, or impose competition on you. The question is how to recognize if a given person is suitable and be sure that they will not cheat on you? By character traits, pay attention to what contribution is made to the assigned tasks to be performed, how this person is working with other friends, and if all quests are well done. The human past is also a very important element. The first impression is key. Do not be fooled, and be vigilant!

We encourage you to visit our Discord or share your impressions about Chop Shop Simulator!

[url=https://discord.gg/ZYkBxed45z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/0d49b199b8bb608ffc3972b8a53ef43952aa9103.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Once you’ve stolen the car and adequately covered its tracks, it’s time to sell it. For this, you will use the tablet with access to a unique internet market. It is a convenient and helpful device because, in addition to selling, there is also the opportunity to purchase the equipment needed for work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/47577000490bbb92ee267a9afaa9257f498fcf91.gif[/img]

You will be able to sell every car for parts. As you can see, some of the easier-to-sell features will be gearbox, airbags, and seats. If the vehicle has not been damaged, it is known that the value is increasing. The better the condition and more valuable the car is, the better you will earn money. But what can you get the richest on? Ofcoursly, on engines. There will always be someone in need of a replacement engine, either for a straight swap, a rebuild, or just to strip for the parts they need.

It would be best if you always remembered that the cops are on guard. Don’t lean too far and don’t get into the sight. Caution in this profession is essential.

Thank you for your attention. What do you think are the most valuable in cars, and what is the best way to earn cash? Share with us and visit our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next part of Chop Shop’s devlog! Today we will talk about how to prepare for car theft and what you need to avoid during the action. But don’t forget, that cops are sniffing around at every step. If you aren’t careful enough, the situation can end badly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/f2b28f06f2cea827efe75c78c50859ef1372b33c.gif[/img]

Your main task is to plan and order the theft of the car, work on it so that no one finds out that it has been stolen, and sell it on the internet marketplace.
Before you start stealing, you need to choose the specific car, do the research of the area, and who the car belongs to. You will need a cell phone and possibly someone to help (at the beginning of the adventure you will act alone). When you decide which car will be yours and take the photos by phone, you have to spot the security, like for example security cameras, light switches, guards and nearest police station. The more things you mark, the easier it will be for you to perform effective action. You must always keep your eyes around your head. It is possible that someone is following you or you have a mole in your crew. Be careful, you don’t want to risk jail, don’t you?

For today’s devlog that’s everything. Maybe you have any ideas, what qualities should a good car thief have?  Share in the comments and check our social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/V4Ev5Bctpr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/0d49b199b8bb608ffc3972b8a53ef43952aa9103.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!
Welcome to the next part of Chop Shop Devlog. Today we will introduce you to police raids. In this industry, you have to take into account the risk. All your actions can end up in jail and a waste of money. Are you brave enough to enter this world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/959c81a0a61649f5f06869f13e0d08ad7fd4f43e.gif[/img]

Remember, that cops can be smart too. The more cars pass through your hands, the more interest will be generated. If you aren’t careful enough then cops will track you down and make a raid. After a successful raid, you lose almost everything, cars, money, and trust among crew members. Nothing is worse than losing your people. Do not forget, that you can plot. If you bribe the cops, interest may drop over time. You have to run smoothly and stay undetected.

That’s all for today. We are curious, what you think about this game. Share your opinion in the comments section and check our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Did you know that playing Chop Shop Simulator you can see familiar places from other games like Car Scrapyard Simulator, Outlaw Driver Simulator, Illegal Transporter and Emergency Road Service because all of them take place in the same universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/e562fe5bc9042fa32eb20cb30f7ead7613aa2dfe.png[/img]

Everything is connected to each other. You can deliver stolen cars for gangs by asking for that Illegal Transporter. You can sell your parts to Outlaw Drivers and buy ones from Car Scrapyard. You can also steal cars from the Emergency Road Service.

As you may see, setting everything in one universe gives you more opportunities.  What is more you can check if our other games interest you too!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hello, Gamers!

Welcome to the next Devlog. Everyone knows that having the right people besides you is key to success. This sentence is also true when we’re talking about our game. Without a proper team, you have less chance to triumph. So how should you choose the right people? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/7a2b910d4c33b15ac009e755edfaba0c2fb73cca.png[/img]

You have two types of them:
[list]
[*] Required for example car thieves.
[*] Optional for example a mechanic who will help you with work on cars.
[/list]

To every single person, you have a trust rate that affects price, the scope of work, entrance to assign localization with better vehicles, and better-paid missions for cars which they steal on their own. 
Everyone in the team has their statistics and perks:
(statistics)
[olist]
[*] Discretion: the chance of being detected during stealing and the chance to be tracked to a chop shop. 
[*] Breaking security: how fast someone can defeat security at the scene of the action (e.g. working out patrols, disabling cameras).
[*] Breaking-in: how fast someone can break into a car without being noticed.
[/olist]
(perks)
[list]
[*] Guide: he/she can choose the most optimal escape route.
[*] Silver-tongued: he/she can chat with the police to buy some time.
[*] Assiduousness: the chance of finding additional hiding security. 
[*] Diligence: how many things from the checklist can be done from your duties if you paid him/her.
[*] Perfectionist: Do everything from a checklist.
[/list]

You have a limit of how many people you hire at the same time. That’s why you have to sometimes dismiss someone to employ someone else.

If you want to hire somebody you need to contact them by phone. 

We hope that you like today’s devlog. Next time we will say something about how to earn money in Chop Shop Simulator so stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Today’s devlog will be about earning money in Chop Shop Simulator. So let’s start!

Your potential client may not like to know that his/her new car is a stolen vehicle. That’s why you need to hide this for example by:

[list]
[*] Changing number plate.
[*] Finding and moving out GPSs 
[*] Repainting car.
[*] Changing parts that are broken after breaking into it.
[*] Polishing serial numbers.
[*] Buying a broken/burned car and swapping VIN.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/bff048c4939b052fd1cd5ac9fe493f3f5bcff558.gif[/img]

You can sell all cars on auction or by parts. It’s your choice but remember that if you don’t do everything to legalize, the police can find you. 

Starting price can affect how fast you will sell your car but it also can interest the police. 

Your potential client can bargain with you so prepare yourself for that and remember that if you wait for the best offer too long you can lose out on it.

Hope you liked today’s devlog. If you want to know more or you have any question join our Discord (https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw)

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! 

We are very pleased to meet you. We are the team responsible for the communication of the Chop Shop Simulator project. We want to bring you closer to the content related to our game. We hope to diversify your waiting time for the premiere with our posts. 

As you may know, in this game you have to steal cars. You might wonder how to do it so here is the answer. 

1. Plan

You can ride around the town and choose what car you want to steal. Spot by your phone security and danger like cameras, nearest police station, security guards etc. The more you spot, the easier your job will be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39570588/d283f0e311fae08a8e2407a5664d93b66b92352c.png[/img]

Decide what kind of people do you need and what kind of action would be (laud - you have more chance to end with success but it’s more possible that police will interest in it and it’s much expensive; or quiet - cheaper, police probably won’t interest this case but you have less chance to end with success).

Plan exactly how to steal, how to escape etc. 

2. Hire the right people to your job (We will talk more about this in the next devlog).

3. Steal and make cash on it (How? You will know it soon ;) )

We hope that you like this short devlog. If you have any questions write comment or join our Discord (https://discord.gg/3jjxqnxQTw)
